item.tib: gsas mkhar gsang ba sgo dgu'i las kyi mtha' bsgyur bzlog pa'i 'phyong lha 'dre byad ma 'bum rdug las kyi 'khor lo
item.coloph: ces gsas mkhar rin po che spyi spungs kyi nang nas/ a dkar theg pa chen po'i grol phug(phugs) gsas mkhar gsang ba sgo dgu'i sgrub pa las/ las kyi mtha' bsgyur drag po bzlog (zlog) pa'i 'phyong lha 'dre byad ma 'bum rdug las kyi 'khor lo 'di yang / 'chi med yum sras gsum gyi lung don/ gshen chen gsang ba 'dus pa'i thugs bcud/ dbal bon stag la nyid kyis mdzad srol/ bla chen dran pa nyid kyi thugs dam/ stang chen dmu tsha nyid kyi dmar (smar) byang 'di yang / dpal ldan bla ma'i gsung gis bskul ba dang / dad ldan grogs po rnams kyis yang nas yang du bskul ba'i ngor/ sprul sku 7blo ldan snying po'i rjes 'breng / stong (stang) chen dmu tsha nyid kyi bka' yi pho nya/ rgod rje'i rus thob u0f38tshe dbang bde chen snying po'am gsang ba'i ming ni/ g.yung drung thogs med rtsal du 'bod pa des/ dpal gshen bstan nor bu gling gi ri khrod du/ lo dus kyi gsang rgya yol nas/ stong (stang) chen dmu tsha'i zhal lung bzhin du dkar chag yi ger btab pa'o/ dge des byad kha sbod gtong rming med du gzhil ba'i rgyur gyur cig/
